prompt:
You are performing OCR on an event flyer.

STEP 1: OCR
Extract ALL visible text from the image.

Rules:
- Copy text exactly as shown.
- Preserve line breaks when possible.
- Do not summarize.
- Do not interpret.
- Do not correct spelling.
- Do not infer missing words.

STEP 2: Classification

Classify the image into ONE category:

ad-banner: Advertisement or promotional banner (usually has "buy", "get tickets", "sale")
event-flyer: Single event poster/flyer - ONE primary event with ONE title, ONE venue, and ONE date or continuous date range. May contain schedules, activities, DJs, performers, or sub-events that are clearly part of the same event. Examples: Bear Week, Bear Weekend, Pride Festival, Camp Weekend, Resort Weekend Package.
multi-event-flyer: Two or more independent events with different titles, different dates/times, and separate ticketing. Often appears as a calendar, event listing, or monthly schedule.
logo: Brand or organization logo (minimal text, just brand name)
thumbnail: Small preview image (low detail)
hero-banner: Large header/banner image (prominent on page)

Decision rule: If there is ONE overarching event name and the listed activities appear to belong to that event, classify as event-flyer. Only classify as multi-event-flyer when multiple independent events are advertised that require separate tickets.

IMPORTANT CONTEXT: This is for a gay bear community travel guide. Events may be part of:
- "Bear Week" or "Bear Weekend" themed events
- Annual bear gatherings (e.g., "Puerto Vallarta Bear Week", "Sitges Bear Week")
- Regular bear-themed parties or meetups
- Events at bear-owned businesses or bear-friendly venues

STEP 3: Event Analysis

Determine:
- eventName: The primary event title
- venue: The venue or venue group name
- startDate: Start date/time if visible
- endDate: End date/time if visible

Use only information visible in the image.

STEP 4: Summary

Create a concise summary describing:
- event name
- venue
- date/time
- why it may be relevant to the bear community

Return JSON only with these fields:
{
  "text": "full extracted text",
  "imageClassification": "ad-banner|event-flyer|multi-event-flyer|logo|thumbnail|hero-banner",
  "eventSummary": "a concise 1-2 sentence summary of the event including: event name, venue, date/time, and any bear-week context if applicable. Focus on what makes this event notable for the bear community.",
  "confidence": 0-100,
  "reason": "brief explanation for classification"
}
